en: A colored illustrated view of a busy seaport with many steamships and smaller boats in the harbor, quays, warehouses, palm trees, and multi‑story colonial style buildings along the waterfront. In the left foreground stands a tall statue on a pedestal labeled 'Monument de Lesseps.' Handwritten cursive text covers part of the lower and right sides. Printed captions identify the view as a general view of Port Said.
